## Activity

This report summarises imaging activity at Hill Counties Health Centre for October 2022. The site recorded 47 captures during the reporting month. The capture total provides the overall activity measure for the period and is used as the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The results below should therefore be read together, with the quality measure describing the proportion of captures that could not be graded and the grading measure describing the number assessed as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 47 captures, 8 were recorded as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 17.0. The ungradable count and rate are reported together to provide both the number of affected captures and the corresponding proportion of activity. These figures form the image-quality result for October 2022 at Hill Counties Health Centre.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This provides the central measure of the time between capture and grading for the reporting period. Taken together, the activity, image-quality and grading measures provide the operational summary for Hill Counties Health Centre in October 2022.
